prompt: An open grabbing hand, closing over a broken box - what's yours is only yours until someone stronger wants it. Rendered as an asemic sigil, not a literal illustration.
style_notes: Blended punk-graffiti reference, owner-ruled 2026-09-24: NYC subway wildstyle (aerosol energy, layered strokes) + UK stencil art in the Banksy-adjacent register (crisp cut edges, social-commentary economy of line) + mystic traditions rendered in the abstract (esoteric sigil/rune quality, not literal religious iconography) - all three blended together, never any one alone. Asemic: letterform-shaped strokes that read as writing but spell nothing, no English lettering anywhere. Painted/sprayed on rough wall material, RimWorld Filth sprite conventions (native alpha, no background).
